none: PAS CAM-26EE15: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine: CONSTANTINOPOLIS
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine: CONSTANTINOPOLIS. c.AD330-340, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: - . Reverse shows Victory standing left on prow. Mint is unknown. Obverse shows Helmeted bust left. Obverse legend reads CONSTAN - [TINOP]OLIS. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.00g,…
